headline: Check Local Parking Permits for Beach and Trail Access
reservation: Montauk requires separate planning for state park vehicle entries and overnight stays. Popular campgrounds like Hither Hills utilize a highly competitive rolling window system; verify current timelines on the official New York State Parks site. Many town beaches require local residential permits during summer; check the Town of East Hampton for non-resident options.

days.title: Maritime History and Military Relics
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM from Montauk Village center

stops.name: Montauk Point Lighthouse
stops.detail: Visit the oldest lighthouse in New York to climb the iron stairs for views of the Atlantic and Block Island Sound.

stops.name: Camp Hero State Park
stops.detail: Explore the former military base's radar dish and walk the wooded trails along the dramatic bluffs.

days.driving: Allow 20-30 minutes for local transfers; conditions vary by season
days.note: Stay on marked paths at Camp Hero as bluffs are unstable.

days.title: Surfing Culture and Soundside Sands

stops.name: Ditch Plains Beach
stops.detail: Observe the local surfing culture at the East Coast's premier longboard break.

stops.name: Gin Beach
stops.detail: Transition to the sound side for calmer waters ideal for wading and paddleboarding.

days.driving: Allow 15 minutes between beaches; parking is restricted in summer
days.note: Summer visitors should consider biking to avoid parking bottlenecks.

days.title: Shifting Landscapes and Ranch Life

stops.name: Hither Woods Walking Dunes
stops.detail: Hike through massive shifting sand mounds that overlook the harbor and bury maritime forests.

stops.name: Deep Hollow Ranch
stops.detail: Visit the oldest working cattle ranch in the USA for a glimpse of coastal equestrian history.

days.driving: Allow 20 minutes; sand roads may require specific vehicle caution
days.note: Walking dunes offer no shade; prepare for intense sun exposure.

intel.title: Seasonal Beach Permits
intel.text: Many shoreline areas require a Town of East Hampton permit during the peak summer season. Check official town websites for updated non-resident daily pass availability near Ditch Plains.

intel.title: Bluff-side Connectivity
intel.text: Cellular reception is often inconsistent near the Montauk Point Lighthouse and lower trails of Camp Hero. Download navigation maps before departing the village center.

intel.title: Village Fuel Points
intel.text: Fuel stations are concentrated within Montauk village; availability diminishes significantly once you head east toward the lighthouse. Ensure sufficient fuel for local exploring before entering the state parks.

intel.title: Midweek Strategy
intel.text: Traffic on Route 27 can create significant delays on Friday afternoons. Aim for Tuesday or Wednesday arrivals to minimize travel time between East Hampton and the point.

intel.title: Tide and Surf Awareness
intel.text: Rocky beach areas at Montauk Point can become inaccessible during high surf or tide events. Always check local marine forecasts before beachcombing near the lighthouse.

plan.arrival: Pick up rental at Tweed New Haven or arrive via New York City; stock supplies in East Hampton before the final drive to Montauk village.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable for main roads; check rental agreements for restrictions on unpaved or sandy beach access points.
plan.goldenHour: Montauk Point Lighthouse for sunrise; check seasonal gates for early access.
